description: Curated staged high-frequency concept lexicon. Words are handles to relation bundles.

stages.label: 6 Months
stages.purpose: Direct embodied roots: body, touch, pain, comfort, near/far, caregiver, basic object handles.

stages.label: 1 Year
stages.purpose: Object permanence, simple action, containment, food/water, early words, simple social response.

stages.label: 3 Years
stages.purpose: Richer objects, language, play, animals, places, before/after, simple cause and category.

stages.label: 5 Years
stages.purpose: School-ready abstractions: number, measure, story, geography/history seeds, rules, truth, society.
